comments.author: Cornelia
comments.body: Can you get this quest if the whole fleet hasn't done it but your the only one who doesn't have the adv fame requirement?

comments.author: Li Yue
comments.body: The person pulling the quest has to have the fame requirement(s). The people who just accept the shared quest do not need to have the fame requirement(s). This is true for all quests.

comments.author: Yaknow
comments.body: There are two quests with this exact same name, this particular one is 2 star and has English and French as a requirement. The other one is a 3 star and has Dutch as a requirement. Both are available at London adventurer's guild. The 3 star is also available in Amsterdam whereas this one is only available in London.

comments.author: oldrobcat
comments.body: Spent ages and lots of QMP trying for Vikings from London Maritime, never found it. However I had no trouble completing the whole Vinland chain from Rollo's Helmet onwards without it. Fell like dominos, just 1-2 QMP. The NOR language seemed to be key.

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
Used 50 QMPs wqithout finding "Vikings", i had french because of an Aide and english from translation notes. Nothing.
Was about to sail to Naples to see if i already did it and could get "Country of the Vikings" when i realised its a maritime quest... not an adventure quest.
All 3 toons had the quest waiting for them at the Maritime Guild, without any QMP, didnt even had to leech it from the Admiral.... *sigh*
